# ViniApp Skills

Portable app-building knowledge and agent-executed build procedures.
Resolve these relative links against the fetched location of this file.

- [Entry point](SKILL.md): routing, scope, and included tools
- [Ship](ship/SKILL.md): idea to a complete testable app
- [Procedures](procedures/SKILL.md): local controller, repair, resume, handoff
- [Design](design/SKILL.md): product identity and interaction states
- [Mobile](mobile/SKILL.md): safe areas, responsive layout, touch
- [Data](data/SKILL.md): real persistence, auth, migrations, APIs
- [Miniapps](miniapps/SKILL.md): requested embedded-host integrations
- [ETHSkills routing](wallets/SKILL.md): link to upstream Ethereum/EVM guidance
- [Games](games/SKILL.md): simulation, input, feedback, score integrity
- [Media](media/SKILL.md): generated art, game graphics, music loops, sound effects
- [Security](security/SKILL.md): secrets, trust boundaries, funds
- [QA](qa/SKILL.md): observable acceptance and evidence
- [Installation](README.md): installing and using the full pack
